csv_project_name: AE for Scenic Road Protection Structure Project
csv_scope_of_work: The COUNTY of Monterey Public Works, Facilities and Parks Department, hereinafter referred to as PWFP or COUNTY , is soliciting proposals from qualified organizations, hereinafter referred to as CONTRACTORS , to provide professional design services for the Scenic Road Protection Structure (SRPS) Project. The proposed SRPS will be approximately 1,040 feet long extending in a northerly direction along the bluff parallel to Scenic Road from the California Regional State Beach (CRSB) to a point between Valley View Avenue and Isabella Avenue.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Land Use Planning, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
